title: Full Diff Ladders on All Entities in Target Schema
description: Add Modification through DiffsConnection ladder for every Entity in target.schema.graphql; merge Modification/Diff/Diffs unions and aggregate EntityEdge/EntityConnection/OwnerEntity; rename AttributesDiff to AttributeDiffs for naming consistency.
summary: Added mechanical Modification→DiffsConnection ladders for weak primitives (Vector/Point/Coordinate/Offset), catalog strong entities (Family through Group), Piece (with PieceModification restored after PieceConnection; Connection ladder anchored in Piece region), Side, Design, Kit, and VCS entities (Change through Conflict). Mapped shared regions: Type→Connector/Representation/Type, Piece→Connection, VCS→versioning entities. Renamed AttributesDiff→AttributeDiffs (+ Edge/Connection/Owner unions). Merged Modification, DiffOwned, DiffsOwned, AggregateEntityEdge, EntityConnection, OwnerEntity, OwnedEntityConnection. Restored Subscription stub types Command/Error. Generator script lives under ticket folder; graphql-core build_ast_schema + cargo test semio/rs pass.
